resources.string: No WiFi yet. Connect the headunit to your phone\'s hotspot.
Open KlikBeam on your Android phone, pick this headunit, then enter pairing code %1$s. How to connect is in Settings › KLIKBEAM.

Mirror your phone screen to the headunit over WiFi. First install the KlikBeam app on your phone (see below).

How to connect: join the headunit to your phone's hotspot, tap OPEN RECEIVER, then in KlikBeam pick this headunit and enter pairing code %1$s. If the headunit does not show up, type the address: %2$s.

Note: mirroring works the phone hard (screen recording, video encoding, WiFi), so it can get hot and drain the battery quickly, especially in a car parked in the sun. Place the phone where the AC reaches it, and stop the broadcast if it feels hot.
First install the KlikBeam app on the phone you want to mirror. Pick your phone.
CLOSED TEST ON THE PLAY STORE
Open the testing page and tap \"Become a tester\".
Install KlikBeam from the Play Store, using the same Google account as in step 1.
Install KlikBeam from the App Store: scan this QR code with your iPhone camera, then tap Get.
Floating mode needs permission to show over other apps. Turn on USB debugging (Android Settings › Developer options), then try again.
Phone mirror is on. Tap for full screen.
